description: How many levels do you want to have to beat to goal?
How many boxes do you want to have to beat to goal?
How many Boxes you want to include, going from the first one to the last one.
Do you want to unlock individual levels?
Do you want to enable individual levels as locations?
Do you want to unlock individual boxes?
Do you want to enable Starsanity? This adds locations for completing levels with every star amount possible (0, 1, 2, and 3).
Do you want to have to unlock individual stars? This adds 3 items per level.
What type of star unlocks do you want? This required Star Unlocks to be enabled.
Individual: There are 3 star unlocks per level, which individually unlock star completion locations for that level.
Progressive Per Level: There are 3 star unlocks items per level, which progressively unlock star completion locations for that level.
Progressive Per Box: There are 3 star unlocks items per box, which progressively unlock star completion locations for that box.
One Per Level: There is 1 star unlock per level, which unlocks all star completion locations for that level.
One Per Box: There is 1 star unlock per box, which unlocks all star completion locations for that box.
One Per Star Amount: There is 1 star unlock per star amount, which unlocks all star completion locations for that star amount.
One For All: There is 1 star unlock, which unlocks all star completion locations.
Do you want to have to unlock 0 star completions? This requires Star Unlocks to be enabled.
